Sculpted ochre walls, a canopy of woven lanterns, and an open kitchen at the centre of it all — Cuore is Masala Diaries' newest home in Rajkot.

The idea

Cuore means heart

Every curve in this building was shaped around that word. The walls rise and fold like something hand-built rather than drafted, hung with woven lantern canopies and masks that catch the evening light differently every hour.

It's a space designed to slow people down — long tables under a sculpted ceiling, a bar at the centre of the room, arched windows that frame the city outside. Cuore is where Masala Diaries brings that idea to Rajkot.
